method: Native SVG constant-RGB silhouette matrix preserves the input alpha channel. First pair applies it to an unchanged pitcher cutout; second preserves the shears silhouette while changing only its ground; third removes it to restore a portrait when internal detail matters. Every source, alpha, image fitting, pose, scale, placement, copy, typography and presentation stays fixed within each pair. No raster editing, automatic tracing or regenerated comparison variants.
